items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: And a fella named Eddie Bell gave me credit, & that's how my first electric guitar came in.

ctx.x: I started learning the guitar, but I was still playing the piano. I'd lay the guitar on top of the piano. But first of all the way I got a guitar was out of a pawn shop for 5 dollars. I just had to have one but I couldn't afford nothin'. But what the guy had -- four strings -- was what I wanted anyhow, so that's how the four strings happened -- I never did graduate. In fact I tell everybody I could never afford the other two strings.

I just kept after it... After I found out I could do a little somethin' with the four I didn't see why I needed the other two in the first place (I did what I wanted to do as far as the four strings. I just left it that way. And a fella named Eddie Bell gave me credit, & that's how my first electric guitar came in. It wasn't a guitar, it was an electric banjo. Great long neck, but I tuned it D like the first 4 strings of a guitar. I played it. I used to get gigs in about 3, to 4 months. I was playin' good enough…
